title: Between Regularity and Irregularity
overview: The filmmaker in conversation with himself. He improvises and through this conversation with himself, he has a chaotic worldview evocative of the firing of nerve cells, clustering sounds of convulsiveness. Finely-detailed images filled with light that have been synced to sound.  Nature creates the glow of light and the beauty of a shape lying between regularity and irregularity. Sounds and images with a granular texture.  These things grasp the depths of the brain to bring forth an overwhelming experience.
